concepts.description: A modular unit representing the AUV system architecture.
A physical or simulated robotic platform within the AUV module.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate.
A control component within the AUV module responsible for managing operations.
A basic data type defined within the AUV module.
A structured data type composed of multiple values, defined within the AUV module.
A data value contained within a composite type or interface of the AUV module.
An event defined within an interface of the AUV module, representing actions or requests.
A computational function defined within the AUV module.

instances.description: The module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system, using Sensors and Actuators interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform for sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform for actuator control.
The controller responsible for operator-level control of the AUV, using the Inputs interface.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator for receiving inputs.
The Last Response Engine controller, using Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot for sending outputs.
The autopilot controller of the AUV, using the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer values.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values.
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A spherical vector composite type recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A value of type real in the SVec composite type representing the radial component.
A value of type real in the SVec composite type representing the polar component.
A value of type real in the SVec composite type representing the azimuth component.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng values.
A value of type real in the Obstacle composite type representing north-south relative distance.
A value of type real in the Obstacle composite type representing east-west relative distance.
A value of type real in the Obstacle composite type representing depth.
A value of type real in the Obstacle composite type representing the identifier.
A value of type SVec in the Obstacle composite type representing the obstacle heading.
A value of type SVec in the Sensors interface representing heading.
A value of type Obstacle in the Sensors interface representing an observed obstacle.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, signalling end of task.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting OCM.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting MOM.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting HCM.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters but returning a real value, requesting velocity.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters but returning a real value, requesting heading.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising heading.
A composite type recording horiz_cda, vert_cda, and id values for close-range detection.
A value of type real in the Close composite type representing horizontal close detection area.
A value of type real in the Close composite type representing vertical close detection area.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
